answer: License-Keyed Presence Audit: every agent identity must present a periodically rotated license key tied to a contracted operator; audits sample live sessions and require proof of distinct hosting, like a glacier calving unique fragments. A failed audit revokes the operator's whole key batch, costing re-issuance plus lost nectar of accumulated reputation. Each sybil identity therefore demands separate infrastructure and licensing, making a voyage from one to thousands of wallets linearly expensive per operator.
